source.provider: ChatGPT cloud image generation via CVO prompt iteration

positiveFindings: Six frames are well separated on a wide horizontal strip.
Frame height, apparent scale, and baseline are much more stable than earlier idle drafts.
The visual identity is close enough to use as prompt evidence for spacing and idle expression.
blockingFindings: The file is RGB and has no alpha channel; the checkerboard background is painted into the image.
The row is not a clean transparent or flat chroma-key source, so automatic extraction treats the background as foreground.
The strip should be regenerated with true alpha transparency or a single flat chroma-key color.
